rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice when the entrepreneur owns and runs a business.

example.english: My friend is an entrepreneur who owns and runs this cha chaan teng himself.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記係我個朋友自己做嘅，佢又係老闆又要打理舖頭。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 hai6 ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 zi6 gei2 zou6 ge3 keoi5 jau6 hai6 lou5 baan2 jau6 jiu3 daa2 lei5 pou3 tau2

rows.note: Use this formal term when emphasizing an entrepreneur as a business founder who takes financial risks.

example.english: An entrepreneur has to take on considerable financial risks in the early stages of starting a business.
example.traditional: 企業家喺創業初期要承擔唔少財務風險。
example.jyutping: kei5 jip6 gaa1 hai2 cong3 jip6 co1 kei4 jiu3 sing4 daam1 m4 siu2 coi4 mou6 fung1 him2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the person's role in starting a business rather than simply owning or managing it.

example.english: She is the entrepreneur who started this social enterprise, which began as a small idea.
example.traditional: 佢係呢間社企嘅創業者，最初由一個小小構思開始。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 nei1 gaan1 se5 kei5 ge3 cong3 jip6 ze2 zeoi3 co1 jau4 jat1 go3 siu2 siu2 kau3 si1 hoi1 ci2
